title: RecipeTin's Lamb Koftas
ingredients: Kofta: 500g lamb mince, 1/2 grated onion, 1/4 cup panko breadcrumbs, 2 crushed garlic cloves
Kofta Spices: 2 tbsp coriander, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp paprika, 1.5 tsp cinnamon, 3/4 tsp cayenne, 1 tsp salt, 0.5 tsp pepper
Kofta Herbs: 2 tbsp chopped fresh coriander
Yogurt Sauce: 240ml Greek yogurt, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 crushed garlic clove, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 0.25 tsp salt and pepper
Salad: Shredded red cabbage, carrot, and mint
steps: Combine all yogurt sauce ingredients in a bowl and chill in the refrigerator for at least twenty minutes.
Grate onion into a bowl, add remaining kofta ingredients, and mix thoroughly using your clean hands.
Divide the meat mixture into eight equal portions and shape firmly onto the eight skewers with damp hands.
Heat half a tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook in batches.
Rotate the skewers frequently and cook for a total of five minutes until evenly browned on all sides.
Serve the warm koftas inside flatbreads with yogurt sauce and your choice of shredded salad.
